was: Fronts the Tchefuncte River near Madisonville. 22 premium + 59 improved (water/electric) RV sites plus 20 unimproved tent sites; reservable online. Boat launch, historic Otis House. --Claude

was: LA State Park on the Bogue Chitto River near Franklinton (2,593 acres, 11 stocked fishing lakes). 81 premium campsites with water/electric (sites 1-46 add sewer; sites 101-135 listed on the water), plus a 7-site horse camp, 4 cabins, a lodge and group camp. Reservable online. --Claude
note: LA State Park on the Bogue Chitto River near Franklinton (2,593 acres, 11 stocked fishing lakes). A 7-site horse camp, 4 cabins, a lodge and group camp. Reservable online. --Claude

was: LA State Park on a 6,000-acre site in the Atchafalaya Basin (Lake Fausse Pointe) near St. Martinville. 20 improved + 14 premium + 12 premium waterfront campsites with water/electric, plus 18 deluxe cabins; also canoe and backcountry sites (water-access, not for RVs). Reservable online. --Claude

was: LA State Park on Lake Claiborne near Homer; 87 RV/trailer sites (20 premium incl 12 pull-through, 67 improved, all water/electric; 2 unimproved) plus a primitive group camp and 10 deluxe cabins. Reservable online. --Claude
note: LA State Park on Lake Claiborne near Homer, with a primitive group camp and 10 deluxe cabins. Reservable online. --Claude

was: LA State Park on Lake Bruin (a Mississippi River oxbow) near St. Joseph; 48 campsites (12 premium incl 3 pull-through, 36 improved, all water/electric) plus 2 ADA standard cabins. Reservable online. --Claude
note: LA State Park on Lake Bruin (a Mississippi River oxbow) near St. Joseph, with 2 ADA standard cabins. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Sabine River Authority of Louisiana park (SRA Site 2) on Toledo Bend Reservoir near Mansfield off LA-191; 117 acres, ~1.75 mi shoreline; 50 RV pads with water, sewer and 20/30/50-amp; gated. Reservable online. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on weekend reservations from March through September, 3 on Easter, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day and major-event weekends (Sabine River Authority fee schedule, 2026-10-12). --Claude
note: Sabine River Authority of Louisiana park (SRA Site 2) on Toledo Bend Reservoir near Mansfield off LA-191; 117 acres, ~1.75 mi shoreline; 50 RV pads with water, sewer and 20/30/50-amp; gated. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Ascension Parish-owned expo center at 9039 S St Landry Ave, Gonzales, with two RV lots (North and West, ~300 sites): 30/50-amp electric, water and sewer, two restroom/shower buildings, WiFi, pads to ~65 ft, fishing pond and walking track. Open year-round but not a long-term facility; RVs only, no tents. Request a reservation on the website's availability form; check-in and check-out at the front desk, Monday to Friday only. Busy during events. --Claude

was: TPWD state park on Lake Tawakoni. Drive-in campsites with full hookups and with water+electric; restrooms with showers, boat ramp, swim beach; also a primitive group campsite. Reservable online. --Claude
note: TPWD state park on Lake Tawakoni. Restrooms with showers, boat ramp, swim beach; also a primitive group campsite. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Historic CCC-built TPWD state park along Clear Fork Plum Creek with a 9-hole golf course and pool. Drive-in campsites with water+electric and full hookups; restrooms with showers. Reservable online. --Claude
note: Historic CCC-built TPWD state park along Clear Fork Plum Creek with a 9-hole golf course and pool. Restrooms with showers. Reservable online. --Claude

was: Andrews County park at the Florey community NW of Andrews; ~70 sites including full-hookup RV sites (30/50-amp, water, sewer) plus grassy tent/vehicle camping; RVs to ~75 ft; restrooms and showers; large pavilion. Pay by phone or at the Andrews Parks Dept office. --Claude
note: Andrews County park at the Florey community NW of Andrews; grassy tent/vehicle camping; restrooms and showers; large pavilion. Pay by phone or at the Andrews Parks Dept office. --Claude

was: City of Levelland municipal RV park off Hwy 385 by the municipal airport; 7 paved pull-in spots with 30/50-amp electric + water. Free for the first 3 nights (permit + $25/night after). --Claude
note: City of Levelland municipal RV park off Hwy 385 by the municipal airport; 7 paved pull-in spots with 30/50-amp electric + water. --Claude

was: Colorado River Municipal Water District park on O.H. Ivie Reservoir; primitive drive-in lakeside camping near a concrete boat ramp (picnic tables, grills, restrooms), no hookups; camping by CRMWD permit (7-day limit), sewage only at approved dump stations; open year-round. --Claude

was: Small locally run RV park at 610 Lady Bird Road off Hwy 6 in Waco, near Lake Waco and Magnolia Market: 25+ full-hookup sites (water, electric, sewer; WiFi included) and a dog park, by the night, week or month (metered electricity on monthly stays). Its Book Now buttons lead to a RoverPass listing that no longer exists; call 254-848-8048 to reserve. --Claude

Daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal and permanent rates; call 361-790-8581. --Claude

was: Adult-only RV park at 2727 E Main St (US-90) in Uvalde; full-hookup sites among mature oaks with an on-site pond; daily, weekly and monthly. Discounts for military and veterans, Good Sam and Escapees. --Claude

was: Private I-10 stopover ~5 mi east of Balmorhea (near the Balmorhea springs). 46 pull-through full-hookup sites, RO water and ice; on-site Saddleback Steakhouse & Circle Bar Saloon. One-night stays book online, longer stays by phone. Desert setting, some highway noise. --Claude

was: RV park at 5001 NW Stallings Dr. on US-59 in Nacogdoches, close to SFASU and the brick streets of downtown, run by a new team of owners and managers who plan to expand it: full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, pull-throughs among them, with Wi-Fi and a dump station, for nightly and full-time guests.  Its rate is camper-reported, since the park has no web page of its own: RV Life reviewers paid $40 a night in January 2026 and $50 in October 2026. --Claude

was: NM state park on the west shore of Eagle Nest Lake (elev ~8,200 ft) just S of the visitor center; single loop of 19 spacious sites (listed 35-107 ft, mixed back-in/pull-through); the booking site lists 20/30/50-amp electric at every site and charges for it, though the park's page still says no hook-ups (2026-10-12); central water and vault toilets, no dump station. Reservable May-Sep, FCFS off-season. --Claude

was: San Juan County-operated RV park at McGee Park fairgrounds SE of Farmington. Large graded lot with electric+water sites (30/50 amp) plus dry-camping sites, dump station; sites ~21x41 ft. Open year-round (site water is shut off Nov 1-Mar 31 but a winter fill station is provided). Permanent RV park, not event-only. --Claude

was: Private RV park just off I-25 in Raton, a convenient overnight highway stop near Sugarite Canyon SP and Capulin Volcano. Level gravel 30/50-amp sites, pull-throughs, big-rig access, tent sites, restrooms/showers/WiFi; nightly. Camper-reported rate: $30 a night in May 2026, $38 in July 2024 (Campendium). --Claude

was: Small owner-run RV park (about 6 full-hookup sites, 30/50/20-amp) on US-180 in Glenwood, within walking distance of town and near the Catwalk NRT; sites reported to fit rigs over 40 ft. Phone/RoverPass reservations. Camper-reported rate: $35 a night (Campendium, October 2025 and April 2026). --Claude
